tasks.gr11-entrepreneurial-qualities-business-: Topic: Entrepreneurial Qualities and Business Plan. Cover personal entrepreneurial qualities, the components of a business plan, viability analysis, and why a business plan is essential. Ask learners to identify entrepreneurial traits from a profile, list business plan sections, or evaluate whether a venture idea has viability.
tasks.gr11-starting-implementing-venture-t3: Topic: Starting and Implementing a Venture. Cover the action plan, steps to start a business, venture implementation challenges, and converting a plan into reality. Ask learners to sequence start-up steps, identify implementation obstacles, or recommend actions to overcome a venture challenge.
tasks.gr11-presenting-business-information-t3: Topic: Presenting Business Information. Cover methods of presenting business information (tables, graphs, reports, oral presentations, slideshows), choosing the right format, and effective visual communication. Ask learners to select an appropriate presentation method for a scenario, interpret a graph or table, or identify strengths of a given presentation format.
tasks.gr11-team-dynamics-conflict-t3: Topic: Team Dynamics and Conflict Management. Cover Tuckman's team stages (forming, storming, norming, performing, adjourning), team roles, team dynamics theories, sources of conflict, and conflict-resolution strategies. Ask learners to identify team stages from descriptions, classify conflict sources, or recommend a conflict-management approach.
